name: tpl-existence-1-goal~p2
task: Grab the key first, then make your way to the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Precedence(has_key, at_goal) requires the key to be grabbed before the goal, and the hard Existence(at_goal) makes the goal required. Together they force has_key, so no separate Existence(has_key) is needed. The door opening is a physical prerequisite of reaching the goal, guaranteed by the environment and not stated in the task, so no clause is needed for it.

texts: Grab the key first: the goal must not be reached before the agent has grabbed the yellow key (has_key).
Then make your way to the goal: the agent must eventually reach the green goal (at_goal).
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
